description:
### Kizu 2.0.1-beta.26

- Keeps the PurpleTV-style independent chat-input suggestion strip and improves provider loading/retry behavior.
- Finds the chat input by its resource entry name and uses Kizu's existing 7TV/BTTV/FFZ catalog.
- Adds starts-with-first, then contains, matching; refreshes suggestions when catalogs or emote images finish loading.
- Reduces provider retry backoff from five minutes to 20 seconds, increases catalog workers from two to four, shortens HTTP timeouts, and logs request latency/status/response size. Test-only prerelease; stable v2.0.0 is unchanged.
